review_basis.predecessor_gate: D092 coordinator gate accepted before D093
review_basis.source_unique_key_guard: passed for stk_factor, stk_limit and stk_st_daily

decision_rationale: The current live ordinary view is valid and its SQL equals the Python authoritative definition. Java reads the existing view through a typed bounded contract; an independent DDL or writer was not introduced.
limitations_reviewed: The Java/Python row comparison covers the first 200 ordered keys on one real date, not the full view history.
The view has no physical WAL, partition, DEDUP or designated timestamp despite the old audit snapshot's WAL field.
